created_by: Dylan L.R. Pollock with Atlas continuity support
description: Master Plan v121.0 advances the physical and computational architecture, establishing a 96 GB pooled VRAM target via three Nvidia Tesla V100 32 GB GPUs, a deliberate dual-PSU power configuration, and a fail-safe liquid cooling containment system. It allocates PCIe bandwidth for 10 Gbps lab networking, defines the requirement for a basic display-output GPU, and documents the transition of Huey Body from modular component fabrication into unified physical assembly. It preserves and carries forward all rigorous operational, testing, logging, and namespace boundaries established in v120.3.

explicit_decisions: The project is organized around Huey Brain, Huey Body, and Huey Farm.
PyHuey GUI is the primary interface and a core runtime component intended for extensive use.
The target canonical Python namespace is hueyos; useful huey and legacy material is to be rewritten and merged deliberately.
Three Nvidia Tesla V100 32 GB GPUs will be pooled to provide 96 GB of VRAM, balancing large-model requirements (~80 GB) with local audio transcription and agentic overhead (~16 GB).
A separate, basic discrete graphics card is required to handle display output and CPU boot tasks since the V100 accelerators are headless.
One PCIe slot is reserved for a 10 Gbps networking card to handle internal lab communication.
Power delivery will utilize two linked, high-capacity PSUs for modularity and deliberate load bearing.

The custom liquid cooling loop utilizes car-grade coolant, a sealed bucket within a garbage bin physical containment system, and a battery backup to maintain pump and fan operation during a power failure.
Huey Body is undergoing final structural assembly, requiring all painting, clear coating, and structural integrity to be rock-solid prior to technological integration.
Huey's role in gaming focuses on strategic analysis and optimal route generation (key/button press logic) rather than direct live gameplay rendering.
Structured records should preserve all useful operational information while excluding secrets.
Transcription is judged by fidelity and will use categories or tiers.
Testing includes unit tests, mocked integration tests in CI, fixture fidelity evaluation, manual live end-to-end tests, and detailed failure-path tests.
Market-available components are preferred; inexpensive Chinese hardware and supply channels may be used when category-specific standards are met.
Only Dylan L.R. Pollock may lock project canon.
source_priority: older plans, transcripts, and archives as lineage
source_basis.inheritance_policy: Carry forward v120.3 implementation evidence and lineage unless v121.0 explicitly changes the direction. Do not present target-state decisions as already implemented.

truth_model.current_reality: Observed hardware, merged code, working commands, and directly verified behavior.
truth_model.accepted_direction: Architecture Dylan has selected for implementation, even when migration is incomplete.
truth_model.provisional_choice: A working selection that remains replaceable through evidence.
truth_model.unresolved: A decision intentionally left open pending additional detail or testing.
truth_model.target_state: A longer-term capability whose implementation depends on resources, maturity, or later validation.
truth_model.historical_lineage: Earlier systems and decisions retained for continuity without overriding current direction.

canon.rule: No agent, tool, contributor, generated document, branch, or pull request may independently lock canon.
acceptance_mechanisms: Dylan intentionally merges a designated canonical update
canon.conflict_rule: Current explicit decisions override older documentation; implementation reality must still be labelled separately from accepted direction.

three_part_architecture.decision: Organize the system around Huey Brain, Huey Body, and Huey Farm.

current_platform.purpose: Primary operator workstation, architecture test bed, and proof platform
current_platform.note: The exact boundary between the current prototype and a polished Huey Brain remains open.

huey_brain.target_hardware_rule: Brain architecture is based around Intel Core i9-class processors from 12th generation or newer.

huey_body.current_boundary: Modular components (head, hands, body) are being unified into a single physical form. Structural integrity, painting, and clear coating are being finalized before the liquid cooling system and computational tech are attached.
huey_body.integration_rule: Brain and Body integration requires explicit interfaces, operator-visible state, safe-stop behavior, and recovery procedures.

huey_farm.role: Scalable compute, model, storage, and support infrastructure.
responsibilities: backup and recovery support where explicitly assigned
huey_farm.planning_scale: 96 GB pooled local VRAM across three Nvidia Tesla V100 32 GB GPUs to comfortably host 80 GB open-source models while leaving headroom.
huey_farm.networking: 10 Gbps dedicated internal PCIe network interface for lab communication.
huey_farm.power_delivery: Deliberate dual-PSU architecture built from high-quality modular units linked together for stable load bearing.
huey_farm.procurement_rule: Refresh model, accelerator, power, cooling, software, and cost comparisons as procurement advances.

unresolved_boundaries: Whether Huey identity spans all three parts or is embodied authoritatively by Brain
Where canonical memory, models, logs, and state reside
Whether HueyOS is installed across all three parts or orchestrates them primarily from Brain

hardware_direction.architecture_baseline: Intel Core i9-class, 12th generation or newer

motherboard_pcie_allocation.slot_1: Basic discrete GPU (stopgap or finalized) for display output and system I/O
motherboard_pcie_allocation.slot_4: Nvidia Tesla V100 32 GB (via extender if necessary)
motherboard_pcie_allocation.slot_5: Nvidia Tesla V100 32 GB (via extender if necessary)

cooling_and_safety.containment: Sealed bucket within a garbage bin physical containment vessel to prevent liquid damage from leaks.
cooling_and_safety.fail_safe: Battery backup specifically dedicated to powering the pump and fans to safely dissipate heat if primary power is lost mid-task.

model_assumption.normal: large models (120B/128B OSS) operating on pooled VRAM
model_assumption.rare: medium models for constrained, fallback, or specialized use

procurement.market_rule: Prefer parts and systems available through ordinary market channels.
procurement.cost_rule: Chinese manufacturers and marketplaces may be relied upon for inexpensive components when practical.

two_of_three_rule.note: Dylan indicated a two-out-of-three approach but the three criteria or authorities still require definition.

pyhuey.accepted_role: Primary GUI and core runtime component
pyhuey.use_expectation: Extensive normal operation rather than optional demonstration use
current_reality: PyHuey exists as a standalone application and an embedded connector path.
The current Monkey-Head-Project implementation still contains external-cockpit wording and incomplete integration assumptions from v120.2.
direction: Move primary operator workflows into PyHuey.
Expose fixed, attributable, reviewable HueyOS capabilities through PyHuey.
Retain a recovery-capable CLI for diagnostics, automation, and operation when the GUI is unavailable.
Avoid duplicating PyHuey with Command Center unless Command Center develops a distinct validated role.

namespace_and_repository.repository_rule: The main repository remains canonical and may merge coherent external scripts, programs, and components.
migration_rules: Inventory every active huey package and import path before moving it.
Choose one destination for each capability; do not preserve competing canonical implementations.
Rewrite and integrate useful legacy code rather than copying it unchanged.
Use compatibility shims only when required and give each shim an explicit retirement condition.
Update tests, scripts, entry points, docs, packaging metadata, and PyHuey connectors together.
Do not claim the hueyos migration is complete until imports, commands, tests, and documentation agree.

pull_request_policy.selection_rule: Use the largest coherent scope that remains understandable and reviewable.

v1_position.decision: Do not lock V1 prematurely. Define it from a system that proves genuinely useful operation under the Monkey-Head-Project umbrella.
minimum_characteristics: repeatable enough for its declared purpose

foundation_proof.path: known MP3 fixture -> media preparation -> local transcription -> API-backed response -> structured log
foundation_proof.interpretation: This remains valuable and should be completed, but does not automatically declare it to be the whole of V1.

open_questions: Who uses it and how often
Whether V1 is Brain-only or requires Body or Farm participation
What repetition and reliability thresholds earn the declaration
Whether the foundation proof is V1, a prerequisite, or one subsystem proof

transcription_and_fidelity.execution_isolation: VRAM is pooled dynamically to prevent rigid blocking; transcription and agentic tasks will be scheduled efficiently within HueyOS to avoid conflicts.
transcription_and_fidelity.primary_quality_rule: Judge transcription by fidelity, not by successful process completion alone.

tier_framework.rule: Category names may be retained or replaced after Dylan supplies the intended tier details; numeric thresholds are not locked.

cognition_provider.rule: Use the API or local provider that best fits the task and architecture; do not bind the system prematurely to one provider.

logging.rule: Preserve all useful operational information while excluding secrets and unnecessary private data.
required_fields: input identity and checksum where applicable
logging.failure_rule: A failed run should still leave the most complete attributable record possible.

testing.failure_detail: Tests should expose stage, input, environment, expected behavior, observed behavior, error context, and recovery result where applicable.
testing.release_rule: Documentation-only alignment may merge without runtime tests; implementation claims require checks appropriate to the changed capability.

implementation_limits: Maintain one active canonical implementation per capability wherever practical.
Mark experimental systems clearly and isolate them from normal authority.
Preserve lineage without presenting obsolete code as operational.
Rewrite and merge legacy code deliberately rather than importing it unchanged.
Do not introduce unexplained hardware dependencies.
Require explicit interfaces, safe-stop, and recovery for Body-facing work.
Require authenticated and observable interfaces between Brain, Body, and Farm.
Keep current reality separate from accepted direction and target state.
Do not finalize V1 until usefulness and participation are defined.

change_log_v120_3: Reframed the architecture around Brain, Body, and Farm.
Promoted PyHuey from external cockpit language to primary GUI and core runtime direction.
Selected hueyos as the target namespace while preserving the truth that src/huey remains current implementation.
Changed V1 from a prematurely fixed fixture proof to a usefulness-led declaration that remains open.
Retained the fixture-to-log path as an active foundation proof.
Added large-model-first and i9 12th-generation-or-newer architecture direction.
Added market and Chinese procurement posture with category-specific safeguards.
Reopened Huey Body as an active rework with bounded safety and integration requirements.
Expanded logging, testing, fidelity, PR-scope, and canon-authority rules.
Separated accepted direction from current implementation and unresolved decisions.
change_log_v121_0: Advanced master plan version to v121.0.
Locked compute accelerator architecture to three Nvidia Tesla V100 32 GB GPUs for 96 GB total pooled VRAM.
Allocated motherboard PCIe slots to support the three accelerators, one basic display GPU, and one 10 Gbps NIC.
Established a dual-PSU power architecture for load distribution and modularity.
Formalized the liquid cooling containment system (sealed bucket in garbage bin) and the dedicated battery fail-safe for pump and fan operation.
Transitioned Huey Body status from modular prototyping to final unified physical assembly and finishing.
Defined Huey's gaming role as strategic analysis and route generation, excluding live rendering.
Updated PyHuey runtime requirement to Python 3.13.
